## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and is at most 72 characters.
- [ ] The PR has one topic and changes less than 400 lines (or explains why not).
- [ ] Tests are added or updated, and they pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation (README, docstrings, `docs/`) is updated if needed.
- [ ] No secret, no API key and no real personal data is added (code, tests, fixtures, screenshots).
- [ ] Calls to LLM or embedding providers are mocked in tests.
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` and explained (`BREAKING CHANGE:` in the description).
- [ ] I understand every line of this PR, including code written with an AI assistant.
